connector.name: Gitlab MCP
connector.registryDescription: GitLab MCP server for projects, merge requests, issues, pipelines, wiki, releases, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-gitlab. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zereight account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use. Create a token with the GitLab scopes needed by the tools you plan to use, such as api or read_api.

env.name: GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN
env.description: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI.

env.name: GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH
env.description: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication.

env.name: GITLAB_API_URL
env.description: GitLab API base URL. Use https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for GitLab.com or your self-managed GitLab API URL.

env.name: GITLAB_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS
env.description: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access.

env.name: GITLAB_READ_ONLY_MODE
env.description: Set to true to expose only read-only tools and block write operations.

env.name: USE_GITLAB_WIKI
env.description: Set to true to enable GitLab wiki tools.

env.name: GITLAB_TOOLSETS
env.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search.

env.name: GITLAB_TOOLS
env.description: Optional comma-separated list of individual tool names to add on top of enabled toolsets.

env.name: GITLAB_DENIED_TOOLS_REGEX
env.description: Optional regular expression used to hide matching tools from the server.

env.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_APPROVE
env.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names that require explicit approval before execution.

env.name: GITLAB_TOOL_POLICY_HIDDEN
env.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names to hide from tools/list.

env.name: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
env.description: Set to 0 only when you intentionally need to connect to a GitLab instance with invalid or self-signed TLS certificates.

env.name: GITLAB_CA_CERT_PATH
env.description: Optional path to a custom CA certificate file for self-managed GitLab instances.
